k1701:
Apartments in the Erdiar Residence at Qerret, on the stretch of coast next to Mali i Robit.

The complex is a recent one, built to current standards, and units are available in several different layouts rather than a single repeated plan.

The position is the draw: Qerret is one of the more settled holiday parts of this coast, and the residence stands close to the water.

Because the sizes differ, the sensible way to choose here is against the floor plans — what suits a couple for the summer is not what suits a family for the year, and both are on offer in the same building.
k1702: Furnished 1+1 apartment in a new building, Shkëmbi i Kavajës
k1703: A 64 m² one-bedroom flat with a balcony on the third floor of a new building with a lift, sold furnished.
k1704:
A 1+1 apartment at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, in a building that is new and has a lift.

The flat measures 64 m²: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom, a bathroom and a balcony, on the third residential floor.

It is sold furnished, so there is nothing to buy before moving in or letting it out — which on this coast is the difference between owning a flat in June and owning one in September.

Shkëmbi i Kavajës is among the busiest holiday stretches near Durrës, with the sea and the everyday shops both a short walk away.
k1705: Large 3+1 apartment by Tregu i Vogël, Durrës
k1706: A 134 m² three-bedroom flat on the tenth floor with two bathrooms and two balconies, near the small market in Durrës.
k1707:
A large 3+1 apartment near Tregu i Vogël, one of the most used parts of central Durrës.

The flat holds three bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen, two bathrooms and two balconies. The certificate records 123.6 m², while the floor plan comes to 133.6 m².

It sits on the tenth floor, which is not the top one, and the building has a lift.

Three bedrooms and two bathrooms is a combination that is hard to find in this part of the city, and it is what makes this a flat for a household rather than for a single buyer.
k1708: New-build 1+1 and 2+1 apartments steps from the sea, Golem
k1709: New apartments at Golem from 40 to 100 m², in one- and two-bedroom layouts, available on every floor.
k1710:
New apartments at Golem, a few steps from the sea, in one- and two-bedroom layouts.

The sizes run from 40 m² up to 100 m², and units are available on every floor rather than only on the ones nobody wanted.

The buildings are recent and built to current standards, with plans that use their area and rooms that take daylight.

Golem is among the busiest tourist stretches of the Albanian coast, with restaurants, markets and services within walking distance — which is why flats here are bought as holiday homes and as letting stock about equally often.
k1711: Apartments in the Illuminari Residence, Kryqi i Kuq, Durrës
k1712: Apartments from 65 to 380 m² in a modern residence at Kryqi i Kuq, with the quoted rate applying to buyers paying 90 per cent up front.
k1713:
Apartments in the Illuminari Residence at Kryqi i Kuq, a part of Durrës that is still filling in.

The residence offers a wide spread of sizes — from 65 m² up to 380 m² — in several different layouts, so it covers everything from a first flat to a floor for a large household.

One point deserves stating plainly: the quoted price per square metre applies to buyers who pay 90 per cent of the sum up front. A different payment schedule will carry a different figure, and that is worth settling before anything else.

The location works for everyday life rather than for holidays: schools, markets, services and public transport are all close by.
k1714: 70 m² commercial unit with rear parking, Plazh
k1715: A 70 m² open commercial space on the main road at Plazh, with a second entrance and parking at the back.
k1716:
A commercial unit of 70 m² at Plazh, facing the main road.

The space is a single open room with a lavatory, which leaves the fitting-out entirely to whoever takes it: a shop, an office, a market, a clinic or a showroom all fit without structural work.

Two things set it apart from the units either side. There is a second entrance from the rear of the building, and there is parking behind it — so deliveries and customers need not use the same door, and nobody has to stop on the main road.

The area carries movement through the year, not only across the summer.
k1717: Working supermarket business, Kodra e Diellit, Tirana
k1718: A trading supermarket of 560 m² at Kodra e Diellit sold as a going concern, with stock, equipment and parking included.
k1719:
A supermarket at Kodra e Diellit in Tirana, sold as a working business rather than as empty premises.

The unit runs to 560 m², with 495 m² recorded on the certificate. It contains two storerooms, an administration office, a lavatory, two checkouts and parking for up to four customers' cars.

Everything on the premises is part of the sale: the stock, valued at around €55,000 at the last inventory, the refrigeration — itself worth somewhere between €30,000 and €40,000 — the tills, counters, display shelving, card terminals, air conditioning and the accounting software.

The shop is trading now, which means the buyer takes over a running business with its customers rather than opening one. The surrounding area is residential and brings its own footfall.
k1720: Apartments in the Orchidea Residence, Mali i Robit
k1721: Apartments of 50 to 70 m² at Mali i Robit, priced by floor and available with payment in instalments.
k1722:
Apartments in the Orchidea Residence at Mali i Robit, a tourist stretch of the Durrës coast a few minutes from the water.

Units run from 50 m² to 70 m² in several layouts, in a building put up to current standards.

The price here is set by floor rather than by a single rate: the first four floors are the cheapest, and each level above them costs more per square metre, with the seventh at the top of the scale. Payment can be made in instalments.

The works are due to finish at the start of next year. This part of the coast rents well through the summer, which is what most buyers here are counting on.
k1723: Furnished 1+1 apartment 250 m from the sea, Mali i Robit
k1724: A 48 m² one-bedroom flat in a 2026 building at Mali i Robit, fully furnished, with climate control in every room.
k1725:
A 1+1 apartment at Mali i Robit, 250 metres from the sea, in a building completed in 2026.

It measures 48.4 m² in total with 42 m² of internal space: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the third floor of a block with a lift.

The flat is handed over fully furnished and finished to a higher standard than most at this size — a multi-split system heating and cooling every room, layered wall finishes, and lighting and joinery chosen rather than defaulted to.

A parking space can be bought separately. Being this close to the water, the flat suits short-term letting through the season as readily as living in.
k1726: Apartments in the Tiktaalik Residence, Qerret
k1727: Apartments from 50 to 100 m² in a new residence at Qerret, minutes from the sea.
k1728:
Apartments in the Tiktaalik Residence at Qerret, one of the faster-developing parts of the Durrës coast.

Sizes run from 50 m² to 100 m² across several layouts, so the same building holds both a small summer flat and something a family could use for longer.

The construction is new and built to a decent standard, and the plans were drawn with comfort in mind rather than to squeeze in as many doors as possible.

The sea is a few minutes away. Qerret rents steadily through the season, which is why a good share of the buyers here are investors rather than residents.
k1729: Furnished 2+1 apartment 250 m from the sea, Mali i Robit
k1730: A 77 m² two-bedroom flat in a 2026 building at Mali i Robit, furnished throughout, with climate control in every room.
k1731:
A 2+1 apartment at Mali i Robit, 250 metres from the sea, in a block finished in 2026.

It covers 77 m² in total with 67 m² of internal space: two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom, on the third floor, with a lift in the building.

The flat comes fully furnished and the work behind it is a level above the usual — a multi-split system serving every room, layered wall finishes, considered lighting and careful joinery.

A parking space is available to buy alongside it. With two bedrooms this close to the water, the flat covers both a family summer and a letting season without compromise either way.
k1732: Two-storey house with a shop on the ground floor, Sukth
k1733: A private house at Sukth on a 300 m² plot, with 232 m² of floor space: a shop below and living rooms above.
k1734:
A private house at Sukth that earns its keep as well as housing a family.

The plot is 300 m² and the building covers 116 m² on each of its two floors, 232 m² in all. The ground floor is a commercial unit — a shop — while the upper floor is laid out for living.

There is a yard with usable space, and the motorway is quickly reached, which matters for a business address as much as for the commute.

Schools and the ordinary services are close by, and the surrounding area is quiet. The arrangement suits a household that wants its trade under the same roof it sleeps in, or a buyer willing to let the shop separately.
k1735: Seven dunams of land at Koxhas, divisible
k1736: Seven dunams of land at Koxhas, priced by the dunam and available in separate parcels.
k1737:
Seven dunams of land at Koxhas, in the country outside Durrës.

The seller will divide it: the parcels can be bought separately rather than as a single block, which changes what the land is useful for. A buyer who wants a plot to build on does not have to take all seven.

The price is quoted by the dunam, so the sum depends on how much of it is taken.

Access to the area is good. Nothing is built here, and the land has been held rather than developed — which is the point for a buyer looking further ahead than this season.
k1738: Compact 1+1 converted from a commercial unit, Plazh
k1739: A furnished 27 m² one-bedroom unit at Plazh, converted from commercial space and suited to one or two people.
k1740:
A small unit at Plazh laid out as a 1+1: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the first floor.

One thing should be said plainly before anything else. The property is registered as a commercial unit and has been converted for living in. The certificate records 27 m². Anyone buying it to live in, or to finance with a mortgage, should check with their lawyer and their bank how that classification affects them.

With that understood, the space itself is well handled — the plan uses every metre, the light is good and it comes furnished.

It suits one or two people, and Plazh fills through the summer, so units of this kind are often held for short-term letting.
k1741: 1+1 apartment in a 2026 building, Mali i Robit
k1742: A 45 m² one-bedroom flat on the fourth floor of a 2026 building at Mali i Robit; the ownership certificate is still being issued.
k1743:
A 1+1 apartment at Mali i Robit, in a block built in 2026.

The flat is 45 m²: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the fourth floor, with a lift in the building.

One detail matters for the timing of a purchase: the ownership certificate has not been issued yet and is expected within about two months. That is normal for a building this new, but it is worth knowing before agreeing a date.

Mali i Robit is both a tourist and a residential area, close to the sea and to the everyday services, and flats of this size let readily through the season.
k1744: 1+1 apartment in a new building, Golem
k1745: A 61 m² one-bedroom flat on the third floor of a new block at Golem, with a lift and close to the beach.
k1746:
A 1+1 apartment at Golem, in a new building with a lift.

The flat measures 60.8 m²: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the third residential floor.

The block is recent and built to current standards. Golem is among the most sought-after parts of this coast, and the beach and the ordinary services are both within easy reach.

The price is quoted per square metre rather than as a total, which is usual for units in a building still being finished — so the sum depends on the exact area agreed.
k1747: 2+1 apartment by the museum gardens, Durrës
